nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=125 beats='Wren, twelve, collector of odd things with stories, spends her birthday coins at the Odds and Ends shop on Tanner Row on a chess set rattling in a biscuit tin; on the bus home she counts thirty-two pale machine-smooth pieces, and then, impossibly, a thirty-third: a thumb-high dark bird, knife-cut, smelling faintly of salt, made by a completely different hand than all the rest.'>>

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=95 beats='The set goes to the rec hall in its biscuit tin, with a card: count them, then ask; the club children do exactly that, every Thursday, loudly and forever.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=95 beats='The wind takes the tide scrap off the jetty rail and lays it on the water; Wren dries the wren in both hands, one clue poorer, and learns what the word fragile means.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Wren keeps the wren in the ranks; from now on every chess set that passes through these hands gets counted to thirty-three, and the odd one always plays.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=105 beats='Sal Doria, once deck boy on the Petrel, talks into the recorder: Tom kissed a little wooden bird before every watch, and we teased him, and we approved; the tape goes to the library, the mystery happily unfinished.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Money changes hands in a velvet hush; weeks later the wren appears online marked rare harbor oddity, priced past any pocket-money apology Wren can imagine.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The skeptics laugh politely and move on; Wren stops chasing provenance, keeps the piece on the windowsill, and lets it face the weather it came from.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The club votes the wren their mascot; every final it stands beside the clock exactly as it did in 1955, and the minutes thank Miss Moss once more, sixty years late.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='Five perches wait behind museum glass; Elsie cuts the ribbon with the knife that carved them, and the applause comes down like returning rain over the harbor.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='The label finally reads true: carved by Elsie Moss to bring a brother home from every harbor; the count of thirty-three was a promise all along, and now everyone who reads it knows.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Pip loses the wren somewhere in the leaf-piles behind the school; dusk shuts the park; Pip cries; Wren says it was only wood, and both of them know better.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=110 beats='At midnight the practice wren stands, slightly lopsided, plainly beloved; the biscuit tin set gains a thirty-fourth piece, and Elsie declares the tradition of one too many begun again.'>>
